verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents notarization, incorporation, translation, apostille and tax/trade registration workflows, but nothing about drafting board consents or resolutions, or routing them to directors for online approval. Its notarization request with signer management is an adjacent capability (certifying an uploaded document), not board-approval collection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can prepare board consents and resolutions and collect approvals online
